notes: TBox delete of a stored rule. Members stay members in every world; a world with the member's value stored by name keeps it, a world that reached it only through the rule loses it (stores). The rule is scoped to British laymen (KnightBachelor and BritishLayman); the prompts say the new members are British laymen (given) and the well-known members' layman status is firm, so only the knighthood gives way. One style before a name: a functional relation, as in the record's axiom. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30 (entitled_to_style is styled_as). styled_as is many-valued in the catalogue; the question takes one value for granted, so Func(styled_as) is a firm background fact here (styled_as_one_value).
